text:
kevin: Heads-up — hotpatch PR ready to merge but we need the rail check: two reviewers on record before the midnight cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7890
maya: looks small, mostly test fix and a tweak to kv cache warmup. can do a pass in ~20m.
sam: i can only look after 22:30 PST, heads up.
ella: i can take it now, will run the smoke flows locally and post results. @kevin tag me if anything specific to check.
deploy-bot: CI status for PR #7890 — unit: green, integration: flaky (2/4), smoke: queued.
ella: quick note — integration flakes look like macOS filewatcher timeouts, i ran smoke w/ linux container: all green locally. pasted logs: ```
[smoke] kv-warmup: OK
[smoke] routing-policy: OK
[smoke] perf-assert: stable (within 5%)
```
ella: left two minor nits inline (naming + comment). not blocking.
maya: thanks, i'm taking a quick look at the diff now. main question: does the warmup change alter batch behavior for long-seq requests?
kevin: behavior shouldn't change, just delays the cache reset on warmup; ran perf on staging earlier today. that said, if you spot a problem call it out.
maya: quick grep looks fine. i'm happy with the approach. leaving a review comment on the naming nit, but not blocking.
sam: sorry late to the party, verified CI artifacts, integration retries show green now. i'm +1 on the change but can't click merge (no perms).
kevin: we need two human approvals to satisfy the release gate. maya, sam, ella — can we get two approvals total?
maya: giving an explicit approve now: APPROVE — :thumbsup:
ella: approving now too. APPROVE + :white_check_mark:
kevin: awesome, thanks all. will merge at 23:50 PST unless any other blockers. running merge script now: ```bash
./scripts/merge_and_cut_hotfix.sh --pr 7890 --cutoff 2023-11-15T07:00Z
```
deploy-bot: Merge triggered for PR #7890 by kevin. Deploy pipeline: started.
kevin: merge completed and cut deployed to staging. keeping an eye on dashboards for 15m. ping me on pager if anything spikes. :rocket:
ella: smoke on staging looks good after deploy, latency stable.
sam: checked tracing for the warmup path, no regressions. good to promote.
kevin: closing loop — will promote to prod at 00:20 PST per rollout plan. thanks for the quick turnaround. :wave:
